motion.name: cut
motion.purpose: Hover and selection swap a fill immediately. No transition duration is set.

motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: The document scrolls smoothly. Reduced motion forces scroll-behavior to auto and transitions to none.

narrative.overview:
PuneAfterhours is four flat color pans for a small crew. The ground is white. Birthday, Wall, Proposal, and What's on are equal jobs, each a solid pan with one fact and one action. The page is not a newspaper and not a poster, and it has no hero.

The bar is white. The wordmark is Zilla Slab in ink, with five links beside it. The link you are on is a magenta chip. The pan you are on has a 4px black rim, and the others do not. A form card wears that same rim. Nothing flashes and nothing lifts. No rule runs between the pans. Only the gap.

One face does the whole page. Zilla Slab at 700 carries the wordmark, names, labels, and buttons. The same face at 500 carries facts and sentences. Italics are not used. Body text on white is ink. A heading inside a pan inherits that pan's foreground: white on magenta, indigo, and leaf, and ink on turmeric.
keyCharacteristics: White ground and four equal pans: magenta, turmeric, indigo, and leaf
One face, Zilla Slab: 700 for names and 500 for facts, no italics
A 4px black rim on the pan you are on, and the same rim on form cards
Black pill buttons that invert to white on hover
The current link is a magenta chip
List rows have no hairline and take the rim on hover or focus

rules.name: The Equal Pans Rule
rules.body: Birthday magenta, Wall turmeric, Proposal indigo, and What's on leaf are four equal fills. None outranks the others. No rule sits between them. Only the gap.

rules.name: The Inherited Heading Rule
rules.body: A heading inside a pan inherits that pan's foreground: white on magenta, indigo, and leaf, and ink on turmeric. A heading on white is ink.

rules.name: The Magenta Mark Rule
rules.body: On white, magenta is the text link, the current nav chip, the day numeral, text selection, the caret, and the scrollbar thumb. It does not recolor a heading on the white page.

rules.name: The One Slab Rule
rules.body: Zilla Slab is the only face. 700 is the wordmark, the names, the labels, and the buttons. 500 is the facts and the sentences. The italic is not loaded and not used.

rules.name: The Working Column Rule
rules.body: Content sits in one column, 1120px wide, under a white bar that wraps so every link stays on screen. Home pans are four columns, two columns at 980px, and one column at 640px.

rules.name: The No Hero Rule
rules.body: The first viewport is the white bar, one lede, and the four pans. There is no hero.

rules.name: The Rim Rule
rules.body: The only depth mark is a 4px solid black rim. It sits on the pan you are on, on every form card, and on a list row under hover or focus. Focus on a control is that same rim, offset 2px. There is no shadow.

rules.name: The Still Rule
rules.body: Nothing flashes, lifts, or eases between colors. A hover swaps a fill. The page may scroll smoothly, and reduced motion turns that off.

rules.name: The Pan Corner Rule
rules.body: A pan and a form card are 18px. A list row and the accepted banner are 14px. A field is 12px.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: A button, a choice, and a nav link are pills. The current link is a magenta pill. An action is a black pill.

rules.name: The Open List Rule
rules.body: A list row does not close with a hairline. Hover or focus draws the 4px rim.

rules.name: The Black Pill Rule
rules.body: An action is a black pill with white type and a 2px black stroke. Hover inverts it to a white pill with black type. A disabled submit stays the black pill at 45% opacity and does not invert.

rules.name: The Current Pan Rule
rules.body: At rest, Birthday wears the rim. Pointing at a pan, or focusing inside it, moves the rim to that pan and clears the others. Leaving the row returns the rim to Birthday. A form card keeps the rim whether or not it is hovered.

dos: Do set the ground and the bar to white, and paint Birthday magenta, Wall turmeric, Proposal indigo, and What's on leaf.
Do let a heading inside a pan inherit that pan's foreground, and set body text on white in ink.
Do use Zilla Slab only: 700 for names, the wordmark, labels, and buttons, and 500 for facts and sentences.
Do mark the pan you are on, every form card, and a hovered or focused list row with a 4px solid rim.
Do make an action a black pill with white type that inverts on hover.
Do mark the current nav link as a magenta chip with white type.
Do leave the pans separated by the gap alone, and leave list rows without a hairline.
donts: Don't add a shadow, a lift, a blur, or a flash.
Don't put a rule between the pans or a hairline under a list row.
Don't add a hero, a second typeface, or an italic.
Don't make the page a newspaper or a poster, and don't bring back a newsprint ground or a red shell.
Don't give a locked plan, a proposal, or an unavailable source its own status color. The line inherits the surface.
Don't collapse the bar into a menu. The bar wraps.
Don't add a photograph or a logo mark.
